text_block_list.text:
While Yaeno Muteki was practicing her 
katas before training, a little girl 
approached and spoke to her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh... She's so cute... I want to protect 
her...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it's almost time for training... 
What on earth should I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—That's it! If I teach this child how to 
defend herself...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you like to train 
together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Splendid answer! Now then, please try to 
copy my movements!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've got great aptitude. I may have 
just stumbled upon a rare talent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next I shall teach you this 
technique—

Yaeno Muteki lost track of time while 
observing the training, and ended up 
skipping her own workout.
